retail.radare2: afij/afbj; same node and edge sets as Binary Ninja
retail.angr: CFGFast exact entry recovered; has_unresolved_jumps=false; approximate block partition (not compared block-for-block)

cfg_comparison.bn_vs_r2_scope: retail image only; this is the only numeric CFG score recorded in the manifest
cfg_comparison.candidate_vs_retail: not address-comparable. Candidate block/edge counts above differ from retail; the compared structural properties are listed under compared_properties.

compared_properties: cdecl two-argument boundary and strcpy of path
loaded path reaches Resource_Unload at 0x004C6144; no EAX write follows before ret at 0x004C6156
Resource_Unload returns kind for 1/3, otherwise Resource_FreeNode result (remaining pool count or relocated node address)
live retail: one call, EAX 0x0000000A (post-unload pool count, no slot swap)
divergences: Candidate Terrain_LoadTexturesAndLightmaps is a 12-block wrapper (335 bytes) that calls Terrain_LoadLightmaps (193 blocks, 5231 bytes); retail is one 20-block, 599-byte function.

Retail .tex texture-list load, 256-entry palette upload and per-page Texture_UploadMipmapPacket uploads into g_b81b20 are host-adapted; the candidate reads TERRAIN.LMP with ifstream and does not register it in the resource table.
Because the .lmp is unregistered, the candidate returns 0 instead of the observed retail 0xA on the loaded path.
Retail App_ContextGetTerrainLightmapsUsed() gate is omitted in the host bridge.
Candidate has host-only null guards; retail dereferences its arguments.
limitations: Binary Ninja and radare2 CFG scores are retail-image structure only. They do not measure candidate equivalence.
angr CFGFast is approximate and splits blocks differently; only the exact entry and unresolved-jump result are used as evidence.
No paired retail/candidate runtime capture exists for this native, so no behavioral equivalence is claimed.
